title: pi-statusline manifest
description: Maps pi extension status keys (ctx.ui.setStatus) to styled footer segments. Optional; consumed by the pi-statusline footer extension.

showInactive.description: Render configured items even when no status is published (dimmed standby marker).

icon.description: Optional leading icon. Omit to show the pi badge image on terminals with Kitty graphics, or the glyph elsewhere.

rows.description: Inline badge height in terminal rows (1-2, default 1) on terminals with Kitty graphics.

image.description: auto (query the terminal for Kitty graphics), on (force the image), off (force the glyph).

projectIcon.description: Show the cwd project's icon (icon/icon_on_dark or icon_on_light, .png or .svg, searched up to the git root) at the right of the pwd line. Needs Kitty graphics.

statusKey.description: The key an extension publishes with ctx.ui.setStatus(key, text).

label.description: Short prefix shown before the value (defaults to statusKey).

color.description: Theme color token for the label.

position.description: Placement hint for footers that order by position.
